summary: The mechanical half of #148's criteria runs by rule against the live forge. Six candidates checked, six excluded: the four revealed #138 pull requests by E1 against the committed 102-entry reservation set, whose digest this record carries, and two of this repository's own recent pull requests by E2 against the recomputed freshness threshold of 2026-03-12 and by E3 on size. E1 compares owner and repository names case-insensitively, as the forge does. No candidate was passed on anything the script could not read - an unreadable field is recorded unknown and unknown never counts as a pass.
establishes: That E1, E2, E3 and E5 are applied by rule on live forge data, that the extended reservation set excludes the burned candidates when a hunt asks about them, and that the record is tied to the exact set it was evaluated against rather than only to that set's path.
residual: Machinery, not selection: E4 and E6 to E10 stay with the curator and E11 with the adjudicator. Every candidate named here is already reserved or a pull request of this repository, which is forbidden material for a cell and can never be a study target. An earlier run, against an 87-entry set since regenerated, is retained under run-1/; its six outcomes are identical to these.
read_from: the probe's own retained output, not asserted beside it
